title: Verifiable pXRD: Hill-climbing pXRD structure determination with LLM agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.17539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous crystal-structure determination from powder X-ray diffraction (pXRD) remains a key bottleneck for self-driving materials laboratories. We formulate the task of pXRD structure determination as a verifiable agentic search problem: candidate structures can be assessed during inference through forward-simulated profile agreement and during evaluation through structural matching to a known reference. To benchmark progress, we introduce pXRD-Bench, a suite of 200 simulated single-phase problems spanning in-distribution structure determination, challenging and polymorphic structures, and controlled compositional and topological distribution shifts. Agent adaptation raises selected structural recovery from 27% to 69%, with further gains from repeated sampling and verifier-guided inference-time scaling. translated_title: 可验证的pXRD：利用LLM智能体进行爬山式pXRD结构测定
translated_abstract: 从粉末X射线衍射数据中自主测定晶体结构仍然是自动驾驶材料实验室的一个关键瓶颈。我们将pXRD结构测定任务表述为一个可验证的智能体搜索问题：候选结构可以在推理过程中通过正向模拟的衍射图谱一致性进行评估，在评估过程中通过与已知参考结构的匹配进行验证。为了衡量进展，我们引入了pXRD-Bench，这是一套包含200个模拟单相问题的基准测试集，涵盖分布内结构测定、具有挑战性的多晶型结构，以及受控的成分和拓扑分布偏移。智能体自适应将选定的结构恢复率从27%提高到69%，并通过重复采样和验证器引导的推理时缩放获得进一步提升。我们通过一个从自我生成的合成数据中学习的反思进化框架，将该方法扩展到实验多相pXRD。
tldr: 本文将pXRD晶体结构测定形式化为可验证的智能体搜索问题，提出pXRD-Bench基准测试集，并利用LLM智能体爬山式搜索将结构恢复率从27%提升至69%，进一步扩展至实验多相pXRD场景。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates pXRD crystal structure determination as a verifiable agentic search problem, introduces the pXRD-Bench benchmark of 200 simulated problems, and uses LLM agent hill-climbing search to raise structural recovery from 27% to 69%, further extending the approach to experimental multiphase pXRD.
